issues.on_page: Student support services: General Fund 312,688 + Activities Fund 269,729
issues.issue: Activities Fund spending of 269,729 (46% of the line) is in this line. The detail records it as student activities (p18). It could be split by column, but keeping the line as printed is also defensible.
The statement counts this in Operation and maintenance of plant: General column O&M 874,430 = General Fund 2600 lines 730,359 + 144,071 (p5). Building and Grounds would match the statement.
